title: Mid-attempt provider limit exhaustion redispatches without losing work
description: When an approver, reviewer or worker session hits a model-account limit mid-attempt, the control plane records capacity.exhausted, holds the spent account, and redispatches the in-flight attempt so its work and any recorded judgement survive. This optional case registers the capacity-limit-redispatch scenario so fault-class filings may cite e2e:capacity-limit-redispatch.

steps.name: create an item the registered scenario may pin

body.title: Capacity redispatch pin {{case}} {{run}}
body.description: Created by the capacity-limit-redispatch E2E case to prove the scenario revision is registered.
